description: Answers 'when is the best day to move' and 'if I leave on this date, am I still resident': how the day the member leaves one country for another plays against both countries' residency day tests, on their logged days: the latest day to leave and stay under the origin's test this tax year, the first year they can be non-resident, and what a given move date would do. Days only; a home, family or work in a country can still make someone resident. The summary field is the one-line answer.

from_country.description: Origin. Defaults to the member's declared tax residency.

move_on.description: A move date to test, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the recommended one.

name: get_best_move_date
title: Best day to move
